WITH ss_sr AS (
    SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_store_sk, ss_sold_date_sk
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN store_returns ON ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk
),
filtered_data AS (
    SELECT 
        s_store_name,
        s_company_id,
        s_street_number,
        s_street_name,
        s_street_type,
        s_suite_number,
        s_city,
        s_county,
        s_state,
        s_zip,
        d1.d_date_sk AS ss_sold_date_sk,
        d2.d_date_sk AS sr_returned_date_sk
    FROM store
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    JOIN ss_sr ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk
)
SELECT 
    s_store_name,
    s_company_id,
    s_street_number,
    s_street_name,
    s_street_type,
    s_suite_number,
    s_city,
    s_county,
    s_state,
    s_zip,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days",
    SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 30) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days",
    SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 60) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days",
    SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 90) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
    SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
FROM filtered_data
WHERE d2.d_year = 2001 AND d2.d_moy = 8
GROUP BY 
    s_store_name,
    s_company_id,
    s_street_number,
    s_street_name,
    s_street_type,
    s_suite_number,
    s_city,
    s_county,
    s_state,
    s_zip
ORDER BY 
    s_store_name,
    s_company_id,
    s_street_number,
    s_street_name,
    s_street_type,
    s_suite_number,
    s_city,
    s_county,
    s_state,
    s_zip
LIMIT 100
